title: Below line
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：below　|　正文 324 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 below 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the trader kept the basket ① below the frost at the stall, and everybody in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: the basket had been left ② below the water line, and nobody had asked a single question. The trader had come to the market two weeks earlier and spoke little of the market he had left behind him.

The list for October 1969 puts it plainer. It was done ③ below a whisper, and the partner who kept the basket had shown it ④ below the level of the road twice before the winter came; nothing in the market was ever done below a whisper in those days. The partner wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ below the cold, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ below the usual price; he was not a man who explained himself, and the market had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was that the basket be shown ⑦ below the bridge, and that the names be written ⑧ below the surface of the desk. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried below the bridge.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985 she kept the basket ⑨ below the frost again when nobody else would, and ⑩ below the water line, she said in 1987, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the basket in the same stall for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the market never forgot what had been done below the water line.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…下面（表时间：below the frost）
B. prep. 在…下面（表处所：below the water line）
C. prep. 低于（表方式／状态：below a whisper）
D. prep. 低于（引出施动者或相关的人：be shown below the level of the road）
E. prep. 在…下面（表原因：below the cold）
F. prep. 低于（表对象／目的：below the usual price）
G. prep. 在…下面（表工具／材料：below the bridge）
H. prep. 低于（表载体／处所：written below the surface of the desk）

items.q: below the level of the road
below the surface of the desk
below the water line, she said

answers.why: below 意为“在…下面”，此处引出时间 the frost（霜期），说明那件小小的货篮是在何时留下的。
below 意为“在…下面”，此处引出处所 the water line（水位线），说明东西被放在何处。
below 意为“低于”，此处引出方式或状态 a whisper（耳语般的声音），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
below 意为“低于”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 路面以下：be shown below the level of the road。
below 意为“在…下面”，此处引出原因 the cold（寒气），说明整件事由何而起。
below 意为“低于”，此处引出对象或目的 the usual price（平常的价钱）。
below 意为“在…下面”，此处引出工具或材料 the bridge（那座桥下）。
below 意为“低于”，此处引出载体 the surface of the desk（桌面以下）：names written below the surface of the desk。
below 意为“在…下面”，1985 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的货篮，此处仍引出时间 the frost。
below 意为“在…下面”，母亲 1987 年那句话引出的仍是那一处水位线。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年霜期前后，货商把那件小小的货篮留在了摊子。（below the frost）
那件小小的货篮被放在水位线，谁也没有过问。（below the water line）
整件事是耳语般的声音做成的，货单上写得明白。（below a whisper）
入冬之前，那件小小的货篮已经由路面以下给人看过两回。（be shown below the level of the road）
叔叔说，整件事是由寒气起的。（below the cold）
他说，家里从来没有人为平常的价钱做过这件事。（below the usual price）
answers: In 1975 the trader kept the basket below the frost at the stall.
The basket had been left below the water line, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done below a whisper, or so the list says.
The basket had been shown below the level of the road twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun below the cold.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it below the usual price.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 below 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the trader kept the basket below the frost, and nobody forgot it.
The basket had been left below the water line for three weeks.
The work was done below a whisper, as it always was in those days.
The basket had been shown below the level of the road twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the basket below the frost again when nobody else would.
The whole market never forgot what had been done below the water line.
